scope: simulation only; independent height-specific stereo estimators
angle_reference: surface: 0 degrees is a horizontal optical axis

requested_rig.relative_rotation: identical rotations in all three axes

manifest.preprocessing: rectify using pair-specific calibration; resize to training shape
manifest.padding: internal convolution zero padding; no external padding
manifest.output: left rectified disparity in pixels at the input resolution
manifest.output_to_original: bilinear resize and multiply disparity by original_width / model_width
manifest.confidence: maximum coarse disparity softmax probability, not calibrated accuracy
manifest.geometry: use original-resolution calibrated Q including principal-point shift
manifest.purpose: high height; synthetic extreme fisheye stereo
